description: Recola tensor-integral (TI) tables: one record per TI with its propagator count N, Recola rank R, the propagator index of every external leg (MOMS, Recola leg order) and the mass id of every propagator (1 massless, 5 top). Families of the v2 recursion must equal these sets modulo logged certified-scaleless and single-coloured-attachment rings (design O7), with QCD corrections at loop orders Born + g_s^2.
provenance: Recola 2.3.0 tree (self-reports 2.2.5) with COLLIER 1.2.8 in workspace/reference, model SM with massless u,d,s,c,b and massive top; dumped from globals_rcl (tiTot, legsti, rankti, momsti, vmti) after generate_processes_rcl by the engine-v2 recola-ninjars study (workspace/tmp/engine-v2/recola-ninjars/recola-count/dump_ti.f90).
recola_leg_order: Recola reorders legs internally (core/currents_rcl.f90:523-563): colour singlets, then antitriplets, triplets and octets of the crossed (all-outgoing) process; MOMS entries follow that order.

processes.recola: u u~ -> g g g g
u u~ -> d d~ g g
u u~ -> e- e+ g g
u u~ -> e- e+ d d~
u u~ -> e- e+ d d~ g
